description: This file defines Pydantic models for a note-taking application's API, including tags and notes, as well as their creation, update, and listing responses.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: A tag object with id, name, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: TagCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a new tag, with name normalization.

classes.name: TagUpdate
classes.description: Payload to update an existing tag, with name normalization.

classes.name: NoteBase
classes.description: Base model for note attributes, including title and content.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a note, including optional tag IDs.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Payload to update a note, with optional fields and title trimming.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Full note object including metadata and tags.

classes.name: NoteListResponse
classes.description: Response wrapper for a list of notes with pagination info.

classes.name: TagListResponse
classes.description: Response wrapper for a list of tags with pagination info.

methods.name: str normalize_name(cls, v: str)
methods.description: Normalizes tag name by stripping whitespace, used in TagCreate and TagUpdate.

methods.name: Optional[str] strip_title(cls, v: Optional[str])
methods.description: Trims the title field in NoteUpdate if provided.
